thread:
jess: P1 alert from pagerduty — canary rollout (eu-west) is seeing ~30% 5xx and elevated latency. Canary is 10% traffic.

alert-bot: [INCIDENT #2315002468] smart-routing:canary-fallback policy tripped — sticky fallback to variant-b triggered 5xx spike.

ana: tagging @ana for SRE oncall handoff — jess, can you confirm customer impact (latency vs errors)?

jess: Impact: frontend errors for users in EU on /v1/chat generate. Error rate up from 0.2% -> 12% on canary path. Non-canary (stable) unaffected. No billing spikes reported.

ana: oncall here (ana). taking. quick read: looks like fallback path is configured as sticky to preserve session affinity — fallback variant is older model with incompatible context length? seeing KV cache evictions and OOM traces.

mike: runtime logs show repeated model mismatch: incoming request metadata expects 'redwood-v2-8b' but fallback variant advertises 'rw-v2-quant-4b' and gives malformed logits -> runtime returns 500.

jess: thinking rollback canary or pause rollout. we have canary controller CLI: `rwctl rollout pause --id rollout_2315`

ana: pause now. also setting fallback policy to non-sticky to prevent oscillation. commands:
```
# pause rollout
rwctl rollout pause --id rollout_2315 --reason "P1 canary failures"
# switch fallback to best-effort (non-sticky)
rwctl routing update-policy --name smart-routing --set fallback.sticky=false
```

ops-bot: Ack: rollout paused; smart-routing policy updated -> fallback.sticky=false.

mike: I also pushed a temporary override to route EU canary traffic to us-central to avoid regional model artifact. `rwctl route update --region eu-west --target us-central --filter 'service==chat'`

nora: product here — any user-visible mitigation we should notify customers about? e.g., partial feature degradation?

jess: customers in EU may see degraded model quality for ~5-10m during mitigation while traffic migrates. No data loss.

ana: digging into config: `canary.policy.rules` had a fallback map prioritizing variants by tag, but we accidentally included `variant:rw-v2-quant-4b` under `prefer_on_fallback:true` for eu-west. That quant model doesn't support streaming chunk metadata — leads to codec errors. I'll open PR to remove variant from fallback priority.

mike: log snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] route[euw-1] request id=abcd1234 -> fallback variant=rw-v2-quant-4b
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] model load error: missing kv_cache_info; reject request -> 500
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] sticky-fallback: attach session cookie -> next requests routed to same fallback
```

jess: That sticky behavior is what amplified the impact — users hit the bad fallback repeatedly. Good call to flip non-sticky.

ana: Next steps: (1) Keep rollout paused. (2) Remove problematic variant from fallback pool for eu-west. (3) Backfill canary with a compatible variant or re-run canary after fix. (4) Run targeted evals on fallback variants to ensure compatibility.

mike: I'm removing variant from policy now. patch: `rwctl routing remove-variant --policy smart-routing --region eu-west --variant rw-v2-quant-4b`

ops-bot: Variant rw-v2-quant-4b removed from smart-routing policy for eu-west.

nora: any telemetry on customer-facing errors we should include in incident report? request ids, top 10 customers affected?

jess: collecting top request ids and customer buckets now. will attach to the incident ticket (INC-2315).

ana: setting post-mortem owner: jess. timeline owner: mike. mitigation window: 14:02 -> 14:27 UTC. Marking severity P1.

alert-bot: PagerDuty: incident resolved? Please confirm.

jess: marking resolved after 14:27 — canary remains paused. manual rollout will resume once QA verifies variant compatibility.

mike: follow-up actions: add unit check in rollout controller to validate variant compatibility (streaming + kv_cache signature) before allowing fallback as sticky. filing GH issue -> #infra/rollouts 472.

nora: customer comms: short note to EU customers affected: "We observed elevated errors for chat in EU due to a canary fallback configuration. We've paused the rollout and mitigated routing; no data loss. We'll provide a follow-up with timeline and fix."

jess: thanks all — nice quick collaboration. closing thread, will update INC-2315 with artifacts. :thumbsup:
